items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-12-30
items.q: Was there a guy named Archer? I'm sure it possibly was his name, Archer. Oh, that's good. He had a chain of ballrooms...

ctx.x: Uh-huh. Let's see now. I was going to ask you about the ballrooms in Des Moines. I wasn't a grass room. Do you remember?

Was there a guy named Archer? I'm sure it possibly was his name, Archer. Oh, that's good. He had a chain of ballrooms that when you got a contract for Des Moines, that automatically placed you with nine jobs, nine ballrooms. In what states? Uh, Missouri, Kansas, North and South Dakota, Iowa, Nebraska. Uh-huh.

Well, I'll have to check on that for more. I'll get that. I'll figure it out. I'm reading articles that you can work on. It's more about him and his name. Uh, what were some of the organizations that hired your band? We talked about in New Orleans you played places like the Sanchez Center?
